WPFTweaksTelemetry.Description: Turns off the diagnostic data, advertising ID, tailored experiences and typing/inking data that Windows sends to Microsoft. Also disables the telemetry and Error Reporting services, Defender automatic sample submission and PowerShell 7 telemetry. Windows keeps working normally.
InvokeScript:
# Disable Defender Auto Sample Submission
      Set-MpPreference -SubmitSamplesConsent 2

      # Disable (Connected User Experiences and Telemetry) Service
      Set-Service -Name diagtrack -StartupType Disabled

      # Disable (Windows Error Reporting Manager) Service
      Set-Service -Name wermgr -StartupType Disabled

      # Disable PowerShell 7 telemetry
      [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT', '1', 'Machine')

      Remove-ItemProperty -Path "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Siuf\Rules" -Name PeriodInNanoSeconds
UndoScript:
# Enable Defender Auto Sample Submission
      Set-MpPreference -SubmitSamplesConsent 1

      # Enable (Connected User Experiences and Telemetry) Service
      Set-Service -Name diagtrack -StartupType Automatic

      # Enable (Windows Error Reporting Manager) Service
      Set-Service -Name wermgr -StartupType Automatic

      # Enable PowerShell 7 telemetry
      [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT', '', 'Machine')

WPFTweaksActivity.Description: Stops Windows from recording and uploading your activity history (apps, files and websites you used). Clipboard history keeps working.

WPFTweaksLocation.Description: Turns off location services for Windows and apps, and stops automatic offline map updates. Side effect: automatic weather location, Find My Device and apps that need your position stop working.

WPFTweaksConsumerFeatures.Description: Stops Windows from installing sponsored apps and games on its own, and reduces Microsoft Store app suggestions.

WPFTweaksWindowsAI.Description: Removes Copilot and the Microsoft 365 (Office Hub) app, disables Recall, the Windows AI service and the AI features in Notepad, and hides the AI settings page. Undo restores the settings only: reinstall the removed apps from the Microsoft Store if you want them back.
InvokeScript:
$Appx = (Get-AppxPackage MicrosoftWindows.Client.CoreAI).PackageFullName
      $Sid = (Get-LocalUser $Env:UserName).Sid.Value

      New-Item "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Appx\AppxAllUserStore\EndOfLife\$Sid\$Appx" -Force

      Get-AppxPackage -AllUsers "*Copilot*" | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers
      winget uninstall -e --name "Copilot" --silent --force --accept-source-agreements 2>$null
      Get-AppxPackage -AllUsers Microsoft.MicrosoftOfficeHub | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers

      if ($Appx) {
          Remove-AppxPackage $Appx
      }

      Set-Service -Name WSAIFabricSvc -StartupType Disabled
      Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -FeatureName Recall -Online -NoRestart

      Write-Host "Windows AI Disabled"

WPFTweaksDeliveryOptimization.Description: Stops Windows from using your PC and internet connection to send updates to other computers (peer-to-peer). Updates still download normally from Microsoft.

WPFTweaksWPBT.Description: Stops your PC's firmware from silently installing software every time Windows starts. Some manufacturer tools, such as anti-theft or vendor utilities, will no longer reinstall themselves. Takes effect after a restart.

WPFTweaksIPv46.Description: Windows tries IPv4 before IPv6 when it connects; IPv6 stays enabled. Helps on networks where IPv6 is badly configured and connections are slow to start. Takes effect after a restart.

WPFTweaksDiskCleanup.Description: One-off action: runs Windows Disk Cleanup on drive C: and removes superseded Windows Update files. Frees disk space, but updates already installed can no longer be uninstalled. Nothing to undo.
InvokeScript:
cleanmgr.exe /d C: /VERYLOWDISK
      Dism.exe /online /Cleanup-Image /StartComponentCleanup /ResetBase

WPFTweaksServices.Description: Sets a few background services to start only when needed or turns them off: Offline Files, telemetry, offline maps, Storage Service and Internet Connection Sharing. Also groups svchost.exe processes based on your RAM, so fewer of them run. Turning off Internet Connection Sharing can stop Mobile Hotspot from working.
InvokeScript:
$Memory = (Get-CimInstance Win32_PhysicalMemory | Measure-Object Capacity -Sum).Sum / 1KB
      Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control" -Name SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB -Value $Memory

WPFTweaksDisplay.Description: Turns off animations, shadows, Aero Peek and other visual effects, and shortens menu and keyboard delays. Also hides the Chat, Task View and Search box buttons on the taskbar. Fully applies after you sign out.
InvokeScript: Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop" -Name "UserPreferencesMask" -Type Binary -Value ([byte[]](144,18,3,128,16,0,0,0))

WPFTweaksPowerPlan.Description: Creates and activates the 'WinTweaks Performance' power plan: processor always at 100%, hard disk never turned off, no sleep or hibernation, wireless adapter at maximum performance. Reduces battery life on laptops. Undo switches back to Balanced and deletes the plan.
InvokeScript: Set-WinUtilPowerPlan

WPFTweaksRightClickMenu.Description: Windows 11 only. Brings back the full Windows 10 right-click menu, without the extra 'Show more options' step. File Explorer restarts to apply it.
InvokeScript:
New-Item -Path "HKCU:\Software\Classes\CLSID\{86ca1aa0-34aa-4e8b-a509-50c905bae2a2}" -Name InprocServer32 -Value "" -Force
      Stop-Process -Name explorer

WPFTweaksDisableExplorerAutoDiscovery.Description: Stops File Explorer from guessing each folder's type (Pictures, Music...) and changing its layout on its own, which makes large folders open faster. Resets your saved folder views and turns off grouping. Sign out to apply.
InvokeScript:
# Previously detected folders
      $bags = "HKCU:\Software\Classes\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\Bags"

      # Folder types lookup table
      $bagMRU = "HKCU:\Software\Classes\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\BagMRU"

      # Flush Explorer view database
      Remove-Item -Path $bags -Recurse -Force
      Write-Host "Removed $bags"

      Remove-Item -Path $bagMRU -Recurse -Force
      Write-Host "Removed $bagMRU"

      # Every folder
      $allFolders = "HKCU:\Software\Classes\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\Bags\AllFolders\Shell"

      if (!(Test-Path $allFolders)) {
        New-Item -Path $allFolders -Force
        Write-Host "Created $allFolders"
      }

      # Generic view
      New-ItemProperty -Path $allFolders -Name "FolderType" -Value "NotSpecified" -PropertyType String -Force
      Write-Host "Set FolderType to NotSpecified"

      Write-Host Please sign out and back in, or restart your computer to apply the changes!
UndoScript:
# Previously detected folders
      $bags = "HKCU:\Software\Classes\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\Bags"

      # Folder types lookup table
      $bagMRU = "HKCU:\Software\Classes\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\BagMRU"

      # Flush Explorer view database
      Remove-Item -Path $bags -Recurse -Force
      Write-Host "Removed $bags"

      Remove-Item -Path $bagMRU -Recurse -Force
      Write-Host "Removed $bagMRU"

      Write-Host Please sign out and back in, or restart your computer to apply the changes!

WPFTweaksRemoveEdge.Description: Uninstalls Microsoft Edge; WebView2, which many apps need, stays installed. Install another browser first. Some Windows features (Widgets, certain links) expect Edge, and a Windows update may reinstall it. Undo reinstalls Edge with winget.
UndoScript:
Write-Host "Installing Microsoft Edge..."
      winget install Microsoft.Edge --source winget

WPFTweaksAdvSystemTimers.Description: Boot settings that keep the system timer ticking at a fixed rate instead of pausing it when the CPU is idle (dynamic tick off, platform tick on, HPET not forced). Can lower input and frame-time latency; costs a little power on laptops. Takes effect after a restart.
InvokeScript:
bcdedit.exe /set disabledynamictick yes
      bcdedit.exe /set useplatformtick yes
      bcdedit.exe /deletevalue useplatformclock

WPFTweaksAdvGamePriority.Description: Gives the program in the foreground longer, higher-priority CPU time slices, lowers the CPU share reserved for background tasks from 20% to 10% and marks games as latency sensitive in the multimedia scheduler.

WPFTweaksAdvFastShutdown.Description: Menus open without delay, and at shutdown Windows waits 1 second instead of 5 for apps and services that do not respond, then closes them on its own. Side effect: an app with unsaved work that hangs at shutdown is closed without asking.

WPFTweaksAdvLatencyTolerance.Description: Sets the latency tolerance values that the power manager and the graphics driver use when deciding how deep the hardware may go into power saving, so devices wake up faster. Higher idle power use. Takes effect after a restart.

WPFTweaksAdvWebSearch.Description: Start menu search only looks at your PC: no Bing web results, no cloud search, no search location and no Cortana on the lock screen.

WPFTweaksAdvDiagnostics.Content: Diagnostic Tracing and Compatibility Telemetry - Disable
WPFTweaksAdvDiagnostics.Description: Stops the diagnostic trace loggers, the disk and power diagnostics tasks, Windows Insider experiments and the application compatibility telemetry. Also turns off the Program Compatibility Assistant and compatibility engine, so very old programs no longer get automatic fixes.
InvokeScript:
Disable-ScheduledTask -TaskPath '\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\' -TaskName 'StartupAppTask' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      Disable-ScheduledTask -TaskPath '\Microsoft\Windows\DiskDiagnostic\' -TaskName 'Microsoft-Windows-DiskDiagnosticDataCollector' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      Disable-ScheduledTask -TaskPath '\Microsoft\Windows\DiskDiagnostic\' -TaskName 'Microsoft-Windows-DiskDiagnosticResolver' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      Disable-ScheduledTask -TaskPath '\Microsoft\Windows\Power Efficiency Diagnostics\' -TaskName 'AnalyzeSystem' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
UndoScript:
Enable-ScheduledTask -TaskPath '\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\' -TaskName 'StartupAppTask' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      Enable-ScheduledTask -TaskPath '\Microsoft\Windows\DiskDiagnostic\' -TaskName 'Microsoft-Windows-DiskDiagnosticDataCollector' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      Enable-ScheduledTask -TaskPath '\Microsoft\Windows\DiskDiagnostic\' -TaskName 'Microsoft-Windows-DiskDiagnosticResolver' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      Enable-ScheduledTask -TaskPath '\Microsoft\Windows\Power Efficiency Diagnostics\' -TaskName 'AnalyzeSystem' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

WPFTweaksAdvFeeds.Description: Turns off the news and interests feed on the taskbar and in Widgets.

WPFTweaksAdvMaintenance.Description: Stops the nightly Automatic Maintenance run, so it cannot start disk, update and scan jobs while you play. Those jobs then only run when you start them, for example drive optimization from the Defragment and Optimize Drives app.

WPFTweaksAdvNotifications.Description: Turns off notification pop-ups and their sound, removes the notification center and silences the Settings, AutoPlay, low disk, printer, Security and Maintenance and Wi-Fi notifications. You will no longer see messages from apps such as chat or mail clients.

WPFTweaksAdvSync.Content: Settings Sync and Shared Experiences - Disable
WPFTweaksAdvSync.Description: Stops Windows from syncing your settings, theme and passwords between PCs through your Microsoft account, and from continuing app sessions on other devices.

WPFTweaksAdvContentDelivery.Content: Automatic App Reinstall and Suggestions - Disable
WPFTweaksAdvContentDelivery.Description: Stops Windows from silently reinstalling preinstalled and manufacturer apps you removed, and from showing suggested content.

WPFTweaksAdvBackgroundApps.Description: Stops Microsoft Store apps from running in the background. Side effect: those apps no longer update live tiles or send notifications while closed.

WPFTweaksAdvTransparency.Description: Makes the taskbar, Start menu and windows solid instead of see-through.

WPFTweaksAdvBiometrics.Description: Turns off fingerprint and face recognition. Side effect: Windows Hello face or fingerprint sign-in stops working; you sign in with your PIN or password.

WPFTweaksAdvWindowedGames.Description: Windows 11. Turns on Optimizations for windowed games, which gives borderless and windowed games the lower latency of full screen, and turns off the variable refresh rate optimization. Replaces any other choice saved on the Graphics settings page, such as Auto HDR.

WPFTweaksAdvCoreIsolation.Description: Turns off Memory Integrity, which uses virtualization to stop malicious drivers. Can raise game performance, but leaves the PC more exposed to driver-based attacks. Undo turns Memory Integrity on. Takes effect after a restart.

WPFTweaksAdvAccessibilityKeys.Content: Sticky, Filter, Toggle and Mouse Keys Shortcuts - Disable
WPFTweaksAdvAccessibilityKeys.Description: Stops pressing Shift five times, holding Shift or Num Lock, or Alt+Shift+Num Lock from turning on Sticky Keys, Filter Keys, Toggle Keys or Mouse Keys in the middle of a game.

WPFTweaksAdvMouseAcceleration.Description: Turns off Enhance pointer precision, so the pointer moves the same distance for the same hand movement whatever the speed (1:1 movement). Applies after you sign out.

WPFTweaksAdvKeyboardRepeat.Description: A held key starts repeating after the shortest delay and repeats at the highest rate Windows allows. Applies after you sign out.

WPFTweaksAdvCsrssPriority.Description: Runs csrss.exe, the Windows process that handles keyboard and mouse input, at high CPU and I/O priority. Takes effect after a restart.

WPFTweaksAdvDataQueueSize.Content: Mouse and Keyboard Data Queue Size
WPFTweaksAdvDataQueueSize.Description: How many mouse and keyboard events Windows buffers. A smaller queue can lower input latency, but a value too small for your CPU makes the mouse or keyboard stutter. Applied as soon as you choose it; takes effect after a restart.

WPFTweaksAdvUsbPower.Description: Keeps USB controllers and hubs fully powered (no selective suspend, no deep sleep) and raises the priority of the USB driver threads, so mice, keyboards and headsets never wake up late. Higher power use on laptops. Undo restores the previous values. Takes effect after a restart.
InvokeScript:
$controllers = @(Get-PnpDevice -Class USB -PresentOnly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.InstanceId -like 'PCI\VEN_*' } | ForEach-Object { "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\$($_.InstanceId)\Device Parameters" })
      $powerSettings = @('AllowIdleIrpInD3', 'D3ColdSupported', 'DeviceSelectiveSuspended', 'EnableSelectiveSuspend', 'EnhancedPowerManagementEnabled', 'SelectiveSuspendEnabled', 'SelectiveSuspendOn') | ForEach-Object { @{ Name = $_; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 } }
      Set-WinUtilRegistryWithBackup -Name 'AdvUsbPower' -Path $controllers -Settings $powerSettings
      Set-WinUtilRegistryWithBackup -Name 'AdvUsbPower' -Path @('HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\usbxhci\Parameters', 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBHUB3\Parameters') -Settings @(@{ Name = 'ThreadPriority'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 31 })
      Set-WinUtilRegistryWithBackup -Name 'AdvUsbPower' -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\USB' -Settings @(@{ Name = 'DisableSelectiveSuspend'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 1 })

WPFTweaksAdvHags.Description: Lets the graphics card manage its own memory and scheduling, which can lower latency. Needs a GPU and driver that support it (NVIDIA GTX 10 series, AMD RX 5000 or newer). Takes effect after a restart.

WPFTweaksAdvNvidiaLatency.Description: NVIDIA graphics cards only. Turns off GPU preemption, keeps the driver's memory contiguous and lowers its power-state latency. Can reduce input lag; some users see driver timeouts with preemption off. Undo restores the previous driver values. Takes effect after a restart.
InvokeScript:
$adapterSettings = @(
        @{ Name = 'PreferSystemMemoryContiguous'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 1 },
        @{ Name = 'D3PCLatency'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 1 },
        @{ Name = 'GPUPreemptionLevel'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'ComputePreemption'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'EnableMidGfxPreemptionVGPU'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'EnableMidBufferPreemptionForHighTdrTimeout'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'EnableAsyncMidBufferPreemption'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'EnableSCGMidBufferPreemption'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'PerfAnalyzeMidBufferPreemption'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'EnableMidGfxPreemption'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'EnableMidBufferPreemption'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'EnableCEPreemption'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'DisableCudaContextPreemption'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 1 },
        @{ Name = 'DisablePreemptionOnS3S4'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 1 }
      )
      $adapters = @(Get-WinUtilDisplayAdapterKey -Vendor NVIDIA)
      if ($adapters.Count -eq 0) {
        Write-Host 'No NVIDIA graphics card found, nothing to change.'
        return
      }
      Set-WinUtilRegistryWithBackup -Name 'AdvNvidiaLatency' -Path $adapters -Settings $adapterSettings
      Set-WinUtilRegistryWithBackup -Name 'AdvNvidiaLatency' -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\nvlddmkm' -Settings @(
        @{ Name = 'DisablePreemption'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 1 },
        @{ Name = 'DisableCudaContextPreemption'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 1 },
        @{ Name = 'EnableCEPreemption'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'DisablePreemptionOnS3S4'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 1 },
        @{ Name = 'ComputePreemption'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 }
      )

WPFTweaksAdvNvidiaHdcp.Description: NVIDIA graphics cards only. Turns off HDCP copy protection on the display output. Side effect: protected video (Netflix, Blu-ray, some streaming apps) may refuse to play or play in low quality. Takes effect after a restart.

WPFTweaksAdvNvidiaTelemetry.Description: NVIDIA graphics cards only. Turns off the NVIDIA telemetry, crash report and daily driver update check tasks, and opts out of NVIDIA Control Panel usage data.
InvokeScript: Get-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.TaskName -like 'NvTm*' -or $_.TaskName -like 'NvDriverUpdateCheckDaily*' -or $_.TaskName -like 'NVIDIA GeForce Experience SelfUpdate*' } | Disable-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
UndoScript: Get-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.TaskName -like 'NvTm*' -or $_.TaskName -like 'NvDriverUpdateCheckDaily*' -or $_.TaskName -like 'NVIDIA GeForce Experience SelfUpdate*' } | Enable-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

WPFTweaksAdvAmdGpu.Description: AMD Radeon graphics cards only. Turns off driver-forced anti-aliasing and anisotropic filtering, the Radeon overlay, frame rate target, stutter mode and GPU preemption, turns on Radeon Anti-Lag (De-Lag) and sets a short flip queue. Undo restores the previous driver values. Takes effect after a restart.
InvokeScript:
$adapters = @(Get-WinUtilDisplayAdapterKey -Vendor AMD)
      if ($adapters.Count -eq 0) {
        Write-Host 'No AMD graphics card found, nothing to change.'
        return
      }
      Set-WinUtilRegistryWithBackup -Name 'AdvAmdGpu' -Path $adapters -Settings @(
        @{ Name = '3D_Refresh_Rate_Override_DEF'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'AllowSnapshot'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'AAF_NA'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'AntiAlias_NA'; Type = 'String'; Value = '0' },
        @{ Name = 'ASTT_NA'; Type = 'String'; Value = '0' },
        @{ Name = 'AllowSubscription'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'AreaAniso_NA'; Type = 'String'; Value = '0' },
        @{ Name = 'AllowRSOverlay'; Type = 'String'; Value = 'false' },
        @{ Name = 'Adaptive De-interlacing'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 1 },
        @{ Name = 'AllowSkins'; Type = 'String'; Value = 'false' },
        @{ Name = 'AutoColorDepthReduction_NA'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'KMD_DeLagEnabled'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 1 },
        @{ Name = 'KMD_FRTEnabled'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'DisableDMACopy'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 1 },
        @{ Name = 'DisableBlockWrite'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'StutterMode'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'GPUPreemptionLevel'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'ComputePreemption'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'EnableMidGfxPreemptionVGPU'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'EnableMidBufferPreemptionForHighTdrTimeout'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'EnableAsyncMidBufferPreemption'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'EnableSCGMidBufferPreemption'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'PerfAnalyzeMidBufferPreemption'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'EnableMidGfxPreemption'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'EnableMidBufferPreemption'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'EnableCEPreemption'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'DisableCudaContextPreemption'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 1 },
        @{ Name = 'DisablePreemptionOnS3S4'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 1 }
      )
      Set-WinUtilRegistryWithBackup -Name 'AdvAmdGpu' -Path ($adapters | ForEach-Object { "$_\UMD" }) -Settings @(
        @{ Name = 'Main3D_DEF'; Type = 'String'; Value = '1' },
        @{ Name = 'Main3D'; Type = 'Binary'; Value = [byte[]](0x31, 0x00) },
        @{ Name = 'FlipQueueSize'; Type = 'Binary'; Value = [byte[]](0x31, 0x00) },
        @{ Name = 'ShaderCache'; Type = 'Binary'; Value = [byte[]](0x32, 0x00) },
        @{ Name = 'TFQ'; Type = 'Binary'; Value = [byte[]](0x32, 0x00) }
      )

WPFTweaksAdvIntelGpu.Description: Intel graphics only. Turns off adaptive V-Sync and the overlay quality enhancement, keeps DisplayPort links fully powered and reserves 512 MB of system memory for the integrated GPU. Undo restores the previous driver values. Takes effect after a restart.
InvokeScript:
$adapters = @(Get-WinUtilDisplayAdapterKey -Vendor Intel)
      if ($adapters.Count -eq 0) {
        Write-Host 'No Intel graphics found, nothing to change.'
        return
      }
      Set-WinUtilRegistryWithBackup -Name 'AdvIntelGpu' -Path $adapters -Settings @(
        @{ Name = 'Disable_OverlayDSQualityEnhancement'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 1 },
        @{ Name = 'IncreaseFixedSegment'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 1 },
        @{ Name = 'AdaptiveVsyncEnabled'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'DisablePFonDP'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 1 },
        @{ Name = 'EnableCompensationForDVI'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 1 },
        @{ Name = 'NoFastLinkTrainingForeDP'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 0 },
        @{ Name = 'ACPowerPolicyVersion'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 16898 },
        @{ Name = 'DCPowerPolicyVersion'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 16642 }
      )
      Set-WinUtilRegistryWithBackup -Name 'AdvIntelGpu' -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Intel\GMM' -Settings @(@{ Name = 'DedicatedSegmentSize'; Type = 'DWord'; Value = 512 })

WPFTweaksAdvCpuPower.Content: CPU Core Parking and Throttling - Disable
WPFTweaksAdvCpuPower.Description: Changes the active power plan so every CPU core stays awake at full speed on mains power: no core parking, minimum processor state 100%, no throttle states, active cooling first. More heat, fan noise and power use; do not use on a PC that overheats. Undo restores the previous plan values.
InvokeScript:
Set-WinUtilPowerSettingWithBackup -Name 'AdvCpuPower' -Settings @(
        @{ SubGroup = 'SUB_PROCESSOR'; Setting = 'CPMINCORES'; AC = 100 },
        @{ SubGroup = 'SUB_PROCESSOR'; Setting = 'PROCTHROTTLEMIN'; AC = 100 },
        @{ SubGroup = 'SUB_PROCESSOR'; Setting = 'IDLESCALING'; AC = 1 },
        @{ SubGroup = 'SUB_PROCESSOR'; Setting = 'THROTTLING'; AC = 0 },
        @{ SubGroup = 'SUB_PROCESSOR'; Setting = 'SYSCOOLPOL'; AC = 1; DC = 1 },
        @{ SubGroup = 'SUB_PROCESSOR'; Setting = '4d2b0152-7d5c-498b-88e2-34345392a2c5'; AC = 5000 }
      )

WPFTweaksAdvSleepStates.Content: Away Mode, Standby and Hybrid Sleep - Disable
WPFTweaksAdvSleepStates.Description: Changes the active power plan so that on mains power the PC never enters standby, away mode or hybrid sleep. Avoids wake-up stutters on a desktop; not meant for laptops. Undo restores the previous plan values.

WPFTweaksAdvCpuScheduler.Content: CPU Quotas and Power Event Processor - Disable
WPFTweaksAdvCpuScheduler.Description: Turns off fair-share CPU quotas between user sessions and the power manager's event processor, so the foreground game is not slowed down by CPU rationing. Takes effect after a restart.

WPFTweaksAdvIntelCpu.Content: Intel CPU - TSX and Isolation Boot Settings
WPFTweaksAdvIntelCpu.Description: Intel processors only. Turns Intel TSX on and turns off isolated user-mode context and in-memory boot settings. Can help some workloads, but TSX is off by default because of the TAA security flaw, so this weakens protection. Takes effect after a restart.
